note: CheckM2 contamination exactly 10%; at ENA as a binned metagenome only.

Escherichia coli, the only representative of this species; assembled from Trip 5 root-adjacent library V42PRr2. Reads of the Trip 5 positive standard (ZymoBIOMICS D6300 preparation; 2 million read pairs, alignments of at least 95% identity) cover 94.0% of this genome, and E. coli was the only community member recovered from that standard. Exclude for ecological analyses.
